channel.title: SEOPlus! Blog: SEO and AI visibility
channel.description: Practical SEO and GEO guides for small and mid-size businesses, by OptimizIA.xyz.

item.title: Website compliance: the four obligations, in order
item.description: Legal notice, data privacy information, tracker consent, accessibility. What the law actually requires of a French business website, what can be checked from the outside, and where to start.
